name: York Pond Dispersed Primitive Camping Area - White Mountain National Forest

management_agency.name: U.S. Forest Service - Androscoggin Ranger District

rules_and_regulations.cost: 100% Free - No fees, no permits required for general dispersed primitive camping
rules_and_regulations.guidelines: Dispersed primitive camping permitted on national forest lands at least 200 feet from roads, trails, and water bodies. Prohibited within Forest Protection Areas.

campfire_rules.firewood_policy: Gather dead and downed wood only.

nomad_connectivity_rating.terrain_obstruction_risk: Moderate (Kilkenny Ridge mountain peaks obstruct line of sight)

seasonal_weather_effects.spring: May thaw: cool (40-55°F), high blackfly season (June), lingering snowmelt.
seasonal_weather_effects.fall: Spectacular New England autumn foliage (50-65°F daytime, 25-35°F nights), prime camping.
seasonal_weather_effects.winter: Severe northern winter (10-25°F), heavy snowpack, York Pond Road unplowed past Fish Hatchery.
